evidence: S4 is componentwise better than U4 on the frozen P2 profile vector for B01 and B14.
In the six-material P2A transfer pilot, continuous profile/storage fidelity remains approximate and no S4 case reaches the R128-vs-R256 numerical comparator.
B06 has no discrete extrema-timing defect in P2A.
B05 shows a candidate-specific 512-observation-step extrema-timing defect.
B02, B11, B12 and B16 extrema timing is reference-observability-confounded because R128 and R256 themselves differ by 512 observation steps.
failure_regimes: B05 extrema timing under the tested alternating wet/dry workload

cost.semantics: Same-job GitHub Actions implementation ratios for tested P2A S4 cases only; not portable speedups.

evidence: G4 is event-sensitive in all six prospectively transferred P2A materials.
G6 improves the full event vector in five of six materials and continuous metrics in five of six; B05 remains event-identical to G4.
Same-partition Richards at B05 G4/G6 has exactly the same event failures as Layer-ROM, excluding reduced closure as the primary cause there.
At B05, G8 improves sign mismatches 9→5 and reversal-sequence mismatches 4→2 relative to G6; U8 gives no event improvement.
The same lower-focused placement advantage appears under conventional Richards.

At G8, conventional Richards has 4 rather than 5 sign mismatches but retains 2 sequence mismatches and 1024-step timing error, so closure is secondary and the tested representation frontier remains below Reference-like event fidelity.
failure_regimes: B05 reversal sequence and timing remain structurally unresolved at the terminal tested eight-state frontier.
G4 is not suitable as a general reversal-sensitive practical groundwater representation.

cost.eight_state_prior: LAYER_ROM_COST1 shows all six screened eight-state implementations resolved cheaper than R16 under shared-host timing, but this is not direct G8 timing authority.

P-ROM-ET.reason: GW and SM practical characterization is not yet mature enough, and existing ROM-ROOT evidence excludes exact layer-mean-head Feddes feedback.

practical_error_map.ROBUST: Used only as a relative development label in P1; not an application guarantee.
practical_error_map.APPROXIMATE_TRANSFER: Candidate remains numerically qualified with useful continuous behaviour but does not reach the fine-reference numerical comparator.
practical_error_map.TIMING_SENSITIVE: Candidate timing differs materially where the Reference ladder itself is sufficiently observable.
practical_error_map.GROUNDWATER_REVERSAL_SENSITIVE: Discrete lower-boundary sign/reversal response is materially less faithful than continuous storage/exchange metrics.
practical_error_map.REFERENCE_OBSERVABILITY_LIMIT: Fine-reference ladder itself does not support clean attribution of a discrete timing metric.
practical_error_map.STRUCTURALLY_UNRELIABLE: Reserved for numerical/water-ledger failure; not the dominant outcome of the retained candidates.

performance_conclusion: A substantial computational reduction signal is robust across prior Layer-ROM cost screens and the direct P2A/P2B same-runner comparisons.
Hydrological fidelity and runtime are intentionally not collapsed into one score.
The retained practical candidates occupy different cost-fidelity positions: S4 is cheaper and profile-focused; G8 carries more lower-zone information but still has reversal limitations.
